name: Savage Display
benefit:
When you spend a swift action to make a performance combat check, you gain a +2 bonus on your performance combat check and gain a +1d6 bonus on damage rolls until the end of your next turn. This extra damage is not precision damage.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 130
When using this feat, you can spend 2 stamina points to gain a +2d6 bonus on damage rolls (instead of +1d6).
flavor: With your victory and a roar, you push yourself on with increased savagery.
